sentences.en: Everybody will have to pitch in to save the environment.
sentences.zh: 每个人都要为保护环境贡献力量。

sentences.en: The lives of most people are determined by their environment.
sentences.zh: 大多数人的生活由他们的环境决定。

sentences.en: Greenpeace is fighting an uphill battle to save the environment.
sentences.zh: 绿色和平组织在保护环境方面处于艰难的斗争中。
